cause_quote: The roles commit added `if (!role || role.agents === "*" || role.agents.includes(params.agentId))` inside `authorizeGatewaySessionCreation` while leaving `agents.list` to return the roster without applying the new allowlist.
user_saw: Operators with restricted roles saw agents outside their allowlist in the Control UI picker and agent directory.
summary: The Gateway filters the agent roster by the current operator role, and the Control UI reconciles its selection against live discovery after reloads and reconnects.
reasoning: The roles launch introduced per-agent restrictions for session creation and runs while the existing Control UI already populated its picker through `agents.list`. I checked the handler before and at that launch and confirmed that it returned the same role-blind roster, so restricted operators could see excluded agents from the first release of named roles. Later roster batching and model-policy changes preserved that behavior.
